SettlementOutcome.title: SettlementOutcome
SettlementOutcome.description: Record-shaped settlement check outcome: settled, unpaid, or declined, plus an optional opaque port-side record reference. Never a billing decision — the invoice record is the authority.

SettlementPortId.title: SettlementPortId
SettlementPortId.description: Opaque settlement-port identity: "port:" followed by a lowercase slug (the shared port grammar; the settlement seam never names a provider).

Timestamp.title: Timestamp
Timestamp.description: UTC instant in canonical form YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.mmmZ (exactly three fractional digits, Z suffix).
